title: OpaPartFileExtensions
description: Additional top-level constants present in `_partN.rego` overflow files (N ≥ 2). These extend the base directive module for the 15 large directives that exceed the 75-requirement cap. A part file shares the same `directive`, `sections`, and `summary` structure as the base file but adds the two properties below.

part_number.description: 1-based part number. The base file is implicitly part 1; overflow files start at 2. DM3440-001 (408 requirements) produces parts 2 through 6.

primary_package.description: Fully-qualified Rego package name of the base (part-1) module for this directive. Enables OPA consumers to locate the primary module when traversing a part file.
